prompts.prompt: Edit target: referenced Moku sprite. Produce a production game emotion SPRITE SHEET, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equally sized cells, transparent background, NO text, NO grid lines. One full-body chibi in each cell, all SAME character as reference: adult female black cat ears and tail, messy straight black hair, white loose shirt, dark shorts, sandals, sleepy eyes. Preserve identity, outfit, palette and crisp pixel-art style. Face viewer slightly right. Consistent body size, feet centered on same baseline within each cell; generous empty margins; no intercell overlap. Row 1 left to right: happy smug grin hands on hips; angry protesting fists and flattened ears; sad slumped shoulders drooping ears/tail; surprised wide eyes hands lifted. Row 2: confused head tilt hand at cheek; frightened recoiling hands near chest ears flattened; relieved soft smile hand on chest; shy blushing looking aside hands together. Exaggerate distinct facial expression and body language readable at 80px tall. Do not include cigarette smoke, props, effects or backgrounds. Keep all eight bodies fully visible.
